research.title: Robustness of Text Classifiers to Meaning-Preserving Perturbations
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare classifier sensitivity to lexical substitutions, punctuation changes, and sentence reordering under controlled evaluation conditions.
Implemented perturbation pipelines and analyzed prediction changes across text categories, manually reviewing examples to distinguish model failures from altered document meaning.

work.title: Order Processing and Inventory Coordination
bullets: Processed incoming orders, checked shipment paperwork against requested items, and coordinated delivery updates with warehouse staff and customer service colleagues.
Maintained inventory records, reconciled discrepancies with physical stock checks, and prepared routine replenishment requests for review by the operations manager.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Sparse and Neural Sentiment Classifiers
bullets: Implemented sentiment classifiers using term frequency–inverse document frequency features with logistic regression and pretrained transformer fine-tuning on a shared review dataset.
Compared classification performance under matched data splits, examining errors involving negation, mixed sentiment, and uncommon vocabulary through manual example review.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Frequency and Graph-Based Ranking
bullets: Implemented sentence selection using word frequency scoring and graph-based ranking, applying shared sentence segmentation and summary length constraints for comparative evaluation.
Evaluated summaries against reference texts using overlap metrics and manually assessed redundancy, entity coverage, and coherence across documents with differing lengths.
